newsitem.title: SWEDEN: ACEA says Volvo, Saab registations mixed in Aug.
newsitem.headline: ACEA says Volvo, Saab registations mixed in Aug.

text.p: The Association of European Automobile Manufacturers (ACEA) said on Thursday that Volvo's new car registrations in western Europe fell 3.7 percent in August while Saab's rose 5.6 percent.
ACEA said Volvo's new car registrations fell to 15,220 compared to August in 1995.
Saab's registrations rose to 5,367 against a year ago.
ACEA said total car registrations rose 5.2 percent in August to 1.16 million.
Saab's market was unaltered at 0.5 percent while Volvo's share slipped to 1.3 percent from 1.4 percent in August last year.
ACEA said western Europe included all European Union countries, Norway, Switzerland and Liechtenstein.
